name: Cometary-Fjard

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the north, dust seas stretching to the horizon. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
The colonists of the ancient alien ruins kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
